lead_raw_text:
The structure of La4Mn16O32 (reduced formula La(MnO2)4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 52 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Mn centers as octahedral, with six O neighbors, and La centers coordinated by eight O neighbors. Oxygen environments include a four-coordinate O site with two La and two Mn neighbors and a three-coordinate O site with three Mn neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include Mn–Mn octahedral edge sharing and corner- and edge-sharing between La and Mn polyhedra.
